train_chunk_sizes = [500000]
train_samples = train_df.iloc[train_chunk_sizes[0]].copy()

class_set_dict = {cls: idx for idx, cls in enumerate(train_df['class'].unique())}
num_classes = len(class_set_dict)

def create_char_features(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text)
    return text + "_" + text.replace(" ", "_").lower()

train_before = train_samples['before'].fillna('').astype(str)
test_before = test_df['before'].fillna('').astype(str)

char_vectorizer.fit(train_before)

X_train = char_vectorizer.transform(train_before)
X_test = char_vectorizer.transform(test_before)

train_class_features = np.zeros((len(train_samples), num_classes))
for cls_name, cls_idx in class_set_dict.items():

if len(test_class_indices) == 0:
    test_class_features = np.zeros((len(test_before), num_classes))
else:
    test_class_features = np.zeros((len(test_class_indices), num_classes))
    for cls_name, cls_idx in class_set_dict.items():
        test_class_indices_with_class = [i for i, cls_name_val in enumerate(test_class_indices) if cls_name_val == cls_idx]
        for i in test_class_indices_with_class:
            test_class_features[test_class_indices[i], cls_idx] = 1

# If test set doesn't have class column, use zeros or handle gracefully
has_test_class_col = 'class' in test_df.columns
if not has_test_class_col:
    test_class_features = np.zeros((len(test_df), num_classes))

feature_matrix = np.hstack([X_train.toarray(), train_class_features])
feature_matrix_test = np.hstack([X_test.toarray(), test_class_features])

after_to_idx = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(after_unique)}
after_idx_to_t = {i: t for t, i in after_idx_to_t.items()}

y_train_labels = train_samples['after'].map(after_to_idx).values

# Train gradient boosting with hyperparameters

    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=4,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    random_state=42,
)

    feature_matrix, y_train_labels, 
    test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validate on true holdout set (never used in training)
y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred_val)

# Generate predictions on test set
test_predictions = model.predict(feature_matrix_test)

# Build submission dataframe with correct ID format

    "id": test_df['id'],
    "after": [after_idx_to_t[idx] for idx in test_predictions]
})
